body:
<!-- pr-reviewer: c3f531381790e15cd3db608e3efc514fedbdad3b -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge**

The #4032 complete-set crossing law is well scoped and well tested: a new `rotary_flow_cross` module holds `refuse_crossed_set`, the adjacent pairs keep their own band-loop law, and the refusal names the two guides and the crossing spot, as the issue asked.

What looks good
- The new law is one call at `rotary_flow.rs:201`, after the set normalization and before the first band is cut; the adjacent-pair refusals are untouched and keep their order.
- The prefilter is sound: a chain-box and a segment-box separating test padded by the exact dust, with a NaN box reading as "near" so the exact solve decides (`rotary_flow_cross.rs:41-45`, `:53-59`, `:91-93`).
- The exact solve reuses the existing Ericson 5.1 `seg_seg_at`, now `pub(super)`; the `MEET_PAIR_CAP` overflow uses `saturating_mul` (`rotary_flow_cross.rs:79` vs `rotary_flow_set.rs:181`).
- The refusal carries the two guides and the crossing point in the text and as the error location; `invalid_at` drops a non-finite spot.
- The adjacent-pairs-left-to-the-band-loop split and the refusal-order trade-off are both recorded in `docs/decisions/4032-rotary-flow-crossing.md`.
- Pinning tests land in the existing `rotary_flow` directory suite and in the lib module; no golden moved.

Results (local worktree build of the PR head `c3f531381790e15cd3db608e3efc514fedbdad3b` at `.claude/worktrees/cc-pr4174-review`; `origin/main` was `e6849c5aea183b81135c8143955cc8c88a429a89`):

- Trial merge: clean (no conflicts; merged with `--no-ff --no-commit`, verified no conflicts, not committed, not pushed).
- `cargo test -p camcraft-motion --no-run`: built clean.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-motion --lib multiaxis::rotary_flow_cross`: 3 passed (the three pinning tests).
- `cargo test -p camcraft-motion --test rotary_flow`: 16 passed, 0 failed, 1 ignored (heavy lane `the_rotor_envelope_stays_gouge_free_at_the_scallop_law`).
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-motion --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.
- `cargo xtask gate light`: NOT RUN - the light lane's release build does not fit the 10-minute command cap on this shared machine; it was started, then stopped before a verdict, and left no result. A motion-scoped attempt (`--only "motion light"`) was stopped too: the motion release build did not finish in time. The 10 light twins that the lane runs (9 in camcraft-motion, 1 in camcraft-app) are all adaptive/troch cases, none of which touch the changed module. The author's own green light-lane run on Windows at head `c3f531381` is named in the PR body (`6 step(s), 0 failed, LIGHT_EXIT=0`). Not claimed as run.
- No example-catalog or app-level suites were re-run locally: this is a refusal-law change to the `camcraft-motion` crate, not a post or a toolpath change; the author's green quick-gate, example-catalog (`43 + 1 + 1`) and light-lane runs on Windows at this head are named in the PR body. No heavy step (P3, no `P1` under the safety floor).

Requested before merge
(nothing blocking)

Questions / notes (not blocking)
- A set with BOTH an adjacent defect and a non-adjacent crossing now reports the non-adjacent crossing first, because the set-wide law runs before the band loop. The decision doc records this; it is deliberate and consistent with the issue.
- The PR body says the reproduction is refused at `(8, 0, 2)`; the refusal location is the witness point on the first segment of the first chain of the pair, which is the crossing point in the reproduction.
- The `rotary_flow.rs` doc paragraphs were de-duplicated as part of the same diff; the file is 419 -> 421 lines as claimed. `rotary_flow_set.rs` (459 lines) did not grow.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
